checklist.why: Water uses material.custom with hand-written GLSL vertex and fragment shaders rather than a stock material.

buildWaterGrid creates a 220x260 subdivided grid and the vertex shader displaces wp.y with a 5-wave sum. Probes show about 470k tris, and animatedDiff of 13.1 shows the animated output changes, so the displacement is running.

The fragment shader computes Schlick fresnel (0.02 + 0.98*pow(1-ndv,5)) to mix body colour and reflected sky. It also adds a sun specular glint from a tight lobe (pow 1400) plus a broad sheen (pow 160) using the half vector.
Procedural value-noise fbm (hash21, vnoise, fbm3) drives rippleField, which perturbs the normal through finite differences. It also modulates the crest colour.
